Geographies Served Programs JAYAM SPECIAL SCHOOL FOR AUTISM AND INTELLECTUAL DISABILITY District Tiruvallur Chennai State Tamil Nadu District Tiruvallur Chennai States Tamil Nadu Jayam Special School is a dedicated institution that provides specialized education, therapy, and vocational training for children with Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD), intellectual disabilities, ADHD, and learning disabilities. Operated under Jayam Trust, the school was founded by G. Sayadevi with the vision of creating a safe, inclusive, and nurturing environment where every child is respected, empowered, and encouraged to achieve their full potential. The school focuses on holistic child development through individualized education plans, therapeutic interventions, life-skills training, physical development, and emotional well-being. Each child undergoes a detailed assessment to understand their unique abilities and needs, allowing educators and therapists to design personalized learning programs. The institution offers services such as special education, speech therapy, occupational therapy, behavior modification, vocational training, computer education, yoga, sports, music therapy, art and craft, and Special Olympics participation. Jayam Special School believes that every child, regardless of disability, deserves dignity, opportunity, and independence. The organization works closely with families to help children develop communication skills, confidence, social interaction, daily living abilities, and employable skills that support long-term inclusion in society. The school has earned recognition for its academic achievements, including consistent 100% SSLC examination results, and for its contribution to the empowerment of children with special needs. https://www.jayamspecialschool.com/ RESIDENTIAL FACILITIES FOR CHILDREN WITH AUTISM AND INTELLECTUAL DISABILITY District Pondicherry Tiruvallur Karaikal Vellore Chengalpattu Chennai Kanchipuram State Tamil Nadu District Pondicherry Tiruvallur Karaikal Vellore Chengalpattu Chennai Kanchipuram States Tamil Nadu Every child deserves safety, dignity, education, and the opportunity to live a meaningful life. Children with Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD) and Intellectual Disabilities (ID) often require continuous care, specialized education, therapy, and life-skills training that many families struggle to provide alone. Due to financial hardship, lack of awareness, and limited access to specialized services, numerous children are unable to receive the support they urgently need. Our proposed residential facility aims to create a safe, structured, and nurturing home for children with autism and intellectual disabilities. The center will provide 24/7 care, special education, speech therapy, occupational therapy, behavioral intervention, physiotherapy, skill training, recreational activities, and emotional support under one roof. Through individualized care plans and professional guidance, children will be empowered to develop communication skills, social interaction, self-care abilities, confidence, and independence. Many parents and caregivers face emotional stress, financial burden, and social isolation while caring for children with severe developmental challenges. This residential facility will not only support the children but also provide relief, hope, and encouragement to families who need long-term assistance and compassionate care. VOCATIONAL TRAINING FOR CHILDREN WITH AUTISM AND INTELLECTUAL DISABILITY District Tiruvallur Chennai State Tamil Nadu District Tiruvallur Chennai States Tamil Nadu Vocational training for children and young adults with Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD) and Intellectual Disabilities (ID) is essential for promoting independence, self-confidence, social inclusion, and long-term employability. Many individuals with autism and intellectual disabilities possess unique talents and abilities, but they often face challenges in communication, adaptive behavior, social interaction, and academic learning that limit their opportunities for mainstream employment and independent living. Vocational training programs At Jayam we are providing the following skill training program 1. Weaving and Handloom training 2. Bakery and Confectionary unit 3. Computer training 4. Tailoring 5. Art and Crafts SPECIAL OLYMPICS TRAINING PROGRAM FOR CHILDREN WITH AUTISM AND INTELLECTUAL DISABILITY District Tiruvallur Chennai State Tamil Nadu District Tiruvallur Chennai States Tamil Nadu Jayam Special School provides specialized sports training through the Special Olympics program for children with Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD) and Intellectual Disabilities (ID), with the objective of promoting physical fitness, teamwork, discipline, and self-confidence. The program includes a wide range of sports and recreational activities designed according to the individual abilities and interests of each child, enabling them to participate in healthy competition and develop important social and communication skills. Participation in Special Olympics activities helps children improve physical endurance, coordination, emotional well-being, and self-esteem while encouraging inclusion, community participation, and personal achievement. The program also creates opportunities for children with special needs to showcase their talents and abilities at district, state, and national levels. Achievements Won more than 1000 medals at District-Level Special Olympics competitions Secured over 100 medals at State-Level Special Olympics competitions Achieved 14 medals at National-Level Special Olympics events held in Pune and Gujarat Through continuous encouragement, professional coaching, and inclusive participation, Jayam Special School remains committed to empowering children with special needs through sports and holistic development. A remarkable fact is that our results in the state board exams have consistently been 100%. We successfully transition 15% of our children to mainstream schools every year. Our holistic programs have helped many children reduce their dependence on medication. • Over 74 students have completed SSLC State Board Exams with colourful marks. We have so far given 100% results every year. • 38 students have completed ITI course in various branches. • Out of them 12 have job placement - TVS Lucas and CVRDE, Avadi, and earning a good salary Vision and Mission Jayam Trust's vision is to achieve and sustain socio-economic development for women and children, aiming to rebuild a sustainable ecosystem in Tamil Nadu.
